alerts.crashLoopPaused: {{subject}} is paused after repeated failed starts

editing.leaveDescription_one: Your change is lost if you leave now.
editing.leaveDescription_other: Your {{count}} changes are lost if you leave now.
editing.stale: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload to see their version; your edits are not kept.

errors.action: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.

confirm.deleteDescription: Its servers stop and it leaves the network. You can restore it while it is kept, 7 days by default; then its templates and volumes are deleted.
confirm.maintenanceDescription: Players without the bypass permission move to the default group, and the autoscaler leaves {{id}} alone until maintenance ends.
confirm.restartDescription: Every server of {{id}} stops and is replaced, a batch at a time. The restart runs as a job under Activity.

create.description: Name the group and pick what it runs; everything else starts from defaults you can change.
create.title: Create group

deleted.description: Deleted groups can be restored while they are kept, 7 days by default.
deleted.title: Recently deleted

detail.chart: Players in {{id}} over the last 24 hours
detail.failed: This group could not be loaded
detail.goneDescription: It may have been deleted; recently deleted groups are listed under Groups.

form.drainTimeoutHint: How long players get to leave a draining server before they are moved.
form.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Server names start with it, and it cannot change later.
form.imageHint: A custom image instead of OgCloud's; it must start with a prefix the network allows.
form.jvmFlagsHint: Added after the runtime's defaults, separated by spaces; each starts with a dash.
form.memoryHint: A Kubernetes quantity, such as 1536Mi or 2Gi. Paper needs at least 1.5 GiB.
form.memoryLimitHint: The server is stopped if it uses more.
form.playersPerServerHint: Each server's player limit, which the autoscaler measures load against.
form.profileHint: The server software and version every server of the group runs.
form.pullSecretHint: The image pull secret's name, if the registry needs one.
form.scaleDownHint: Empty servers drain when load falls under this share.
form.scaleUpHint: Another server starts when load passes this share.
form.storageHint: Space for the server's files, such as 10Gi. Empty uses the cluster's default.

typeHint.DYNAMIC: Identical servers the autoscaler adds and removes; each starts fresh from the template.
typeHint.PROXY: Velocity proxies that players connect through.
typeHint.STATIC: One server whose files live on a volume and are saved back when it stops.

link.description: This network lets only players with a linked Minecraft account use the dashboard. Join the network, then enter your player name.
link.noAccess: Your role gives you no access to this network's dashboard. Ask an owner for one.
link.offline: {{name}} is not online. Join the network first, then send the code again.
link.sent: A code is waiting for {{name}} in the game's chat.
link.taken: That player is linked to another user.
link.title: Link your Minecraft account
link.wrongCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Send a new one.

overview.eula: Servers will not start until an owner accepts the Minecraft EULA.

groups.emptyDescription: Create a proxy group and a lobby to let players in.
groups.title: Groups

overview.maintenanceDescription: Only players with the bypass permission can join, and everyone else is disconnected. The autoscaler pauses until maintenance ends.
overview.maintenanceOn: In maintenance: only players with the bypass permission can join

players.empty: The history fills in once the controller has sampled for a few minutes.
players.title: Players online

reasons.STATIC: A static group keeps its one server

servers.pausedReason: Its servers kept failing to start. Fix the cause, then resume.
servers.title: Servers

palette.placeholder: Search or go to a page

players.description: Everyone online now, and every player the network has seen.

detail.failed: This player could not be loaded
detail.unknownDescription: The network knows only players who joined at least once.

empty.knownDescription: Names match from their start; try fewer letters.
empty.onlineDescription: Players appear here as soon as they join through a proxy.

kick.description: They are disconnected and see this message; they can join again.
kick.title: Kick {{name}}?

rank.description: The new rank applies at once, on every server the player is on.
rank.title: Set the rank of {{name}}
rank.untilHint: When it ends, the player falls back to the default group.

transfer.description: A group places the player by the network's routing strategy; a server takes them directly.
transfer.title: Move {{name}}

actions.pushing: Pushing the files of {{name}} as a new template version

command.description: It runs as the server console. Its output goes to the server's log, not here.
command.title: Run a console command

confirm.killDescription: The pod is deleted at once. Its players are disconnected and anything not saved is lost.
confirm.pushDynamic: Its files become a new template version of {{group}}, which servers use once you promote it.
confirm.pushStatic: Its files become a new template version of {{group}}, which the group uses at once.
confirm.stopDescription: Players move to other servers first; an empty or starting server stops at once.

detail.failed: This server could not be loaded
detail.goneDescription: It stopped and left the live state. Its group starts others as needed.
detail.idHint: Pods and logs carry this id; the short name above is the last six characters players see.

empty.filteredDescription: Clear the filters or search for another name.
empty.noneDescription: Groups start servers on their own once the Minecraft EULA is accepted; request one to start now.

move.description: Everyone on the server goes to another group, placed by the network's routing strategy.
move.title: Move the players on {{name}}

request.description: One more server of the group starts as soon as the controller gets to it.
request.title: Request a server

errors.BAD_COLOUR: Not a colour: use a name such as red or a code such as #ff8800.
errors.COLOUR_COUNT: A colour tag takes exactly one colour.
errors.GRADIENT_STOPS: A gradient needs at least two colours.
errors.LONE_ANGLE: This < starts no tag; write \< to show the character.
errors.MISSING_PLACEHOLDER: This text must show a placeholder it is missing, such as {name}.
errors.SECTION_SIGN: § codes are not allowed; use tags instead.
errors.TAG_ARGUMENTS: This tag takes no values after a colon.
errors.UNKNOWN_PLACEHOLDER: This text offers no such placeholder.
